answer: Sybil resistance is a prepaid replay gate. A newcomer locks a slashable bond that becomes the anchor of every later claim about that key. Unproven keys may enter only through a scarce compute oasis with a hard cap of admission slots per window, so a clone farm pays wall-clock delay, not just signatures. Each slot runs a specified function over public inputs; independent miners recompute it and attest only when their digest is a crystal match of the submitted one. A mismatch slashes the bond, so mass fake identities burn capital faster than they can farm rewards or votes.
